messages.subject: Re: build exit status 18 - how to solve?
parts:
I've seen very poor behavior downloading nlopt from http://ab-initio.mit.edu/
In fact, I often can't even hit the web page.
I will update the nloptr installer to fetch from GitHub instead.

You can follow here: https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps-package-dependencies/issues/97
